versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-extract-videos-comments-hot

- Provides 4 core Douyin (抖音) public data tools: keyword search, batch author posts extraction, video comment analysis, and real-time hot list queries.
- Supports typical use cases such as content research, competitor analysis, comment insights, and trending topic tracking.
- Strictly limited to public Douyin data; does not support publishing, editing, downloading videos, or accessing private/insight data.
- Simple CLI with clear parameter validation, structured JSON output, and comprehensive error handling.
- Designed for domestic users: all-Chinese interface, no proxy required, China-hosted API.
- Prioritizes security and compliance: token via env only, adheres to API rate limits, no log or file leaks.
